runs.name: ean_and_semantic_to_offers
runs.finding: EAN queries produced unrelated Mercado Livre offers such as biscuits, cleaning cloths, tape and medical tape. The gate correctly excluded every price.

runs.name: semantic_to_product_details_to_offers_v1

false_accept.root_cause: The Google Product Offers cluster did not preserve the variant represented by the Google Product detail.

runs.finding: Product-detail identity alone cannot authorize the downstream offer price.

runs.name: semantic_to_details_with_independent_offer_gate_v2
runs.finding: The corrected offer-level gate rejected the Linea offers for the Crystal product. No accepted Mercado Livre offer remained.

repeatability.example: A correct Linea Mercado Livre offer was returned in v1 but no Mercado Livre offer was returned for the same product in v2.

reason: Google Shopping did not provide reliable EAN identity; Google Product Offers could cross product variants; corrected precision reduced accepted price coverage to zero.
